raw.details:
We, the members of CSI SBC VNRVJIET, are organizing VJ Hackathon 2k26 - Victory and Joy in Smart Innovations, in collaboration with the Department of Computer Science and Engineering. VJ Hackathon is scheduled to take place on October 14th and 15th, 2026. This hackathon will bring together participants and respected judges from different parts of India.

The domains under the hackathon include:

  • Agriculture
  • Climate & Ocean Intelligence
  • HealthCare

Hackathon Process:

  • Select a problem statement from one of the given domains.
  • Submit your solution in PPT or PDF format by 30th September 2026, following the provided sample abstract template, through the Unstop platform.
  • Teams will be shortlisted based on their abstract and the results will be published on our social media handle on 9th October, 2026.
  • Further communication for the shortlisted participants will be made via email.
  • Team size: Maximum of 3 students and 1 mentor (Mentor is optional).
  • This is the drive link to access the problem statements, instructions document, submission guide video and sample abstract PPT: VJH 2026

Cash prizes:

  • Compete for a prize pool worth ₹1,00,000.
  • All participants will receive participation certificates, and finalists will be awarded appreciation certificates.

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Ensure all team details are clearly mentioned in the submission.
  • Team size: 1 - 3 members and a mentor (Mentor is optional)
  • The abstract PPT or PDF MUST be submitted on or before 30th September, 2026. Make sure to mention the problem statement number and name.
  • The shortlisted teams will be notified by 9th October, 2026.
  • Please follow the given format for the abstract PPT or PDF, or else your registration will be regarded as invalid.
  • There is NO registration fee.
  • Cross-year, cross-specialization, and cross-college teams are allowed.
  • The hackathon will follow a 24-hour format.
  • The hackathon will be held at the VNRVJIET campus, Hyderabad.
  • Accommodation and refreshments will be provided at the venue for the entire duration of the hackathon, from 11:00 AM on October 14th to 11:00 AM on October 15th, 2026.
  • The organizers will not be responsible for any action taken as a consequence of the violation of rules.
  • For further details, kindly visit our website, Instagram and Linkedin.

Stay Connected with VJ Hackathon 2k26:

  •  Stay updated with important announcements, deadlines, and other event-related updates.
  •  Join the VJ Hackathon 2k26 WhatsApp Channel
